verdict.rationale: Pulley explicitly offers in-platform 409A valuations with a fast 3-day turnaround (pulley-docs-10), and its cap table is treated as the live source of truth (pulley-docs-1, pulley-docs-3), implying valuations draw from live data. However, there's no explicit evidence of 'audit-ready' certification/audit trail, nor of scheduled/refresh automation for recurring valuations. missing for 10: explicit audit-ready/audit-defense documentation, evidence of automatic scheduled refresh cadence tied to cap table changes.
